rss: G7 to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel after Trump threat
title: Toy Car Fuel Prices Roll Down
story: Toy car factories have found a way to get more fuel for their little vehicles. This means they can make and sell toy cars at a better price.
storyBig: A coordinated release of toy car fuel has been announced to stabilize prices and ensure supply, preventing potential shortages. This move is expected to keep toy car prices more affordable for everyone.
think: Why is it important to have enough fuel for toy cars?
bull: More fuel means toy cars are cheaper to make and buy.
bear: If the fuel runs out again, prices might go up.

rss: No more cereal at the end of the aisle? New rules in Scotland's supermarkets
title: Sugary Cereal Moves in Supermarket
story: Some stores have decided to move sugary cereals to a different part of the store. This makes it easier to find healthier choices.
storyBig: New regulations require supermarkets to reposition high-sugar cereals away from prominent aisles to encourage healthier shopping habits. This change aims to highlight and promote more nutritious options to shoppers.
think: What can stores do to help people pick healthy foods?
bull: More people might try healthy cereals now.
bear: Some kids might miss seeing their favorite cereal.
